parsed.post: My latest run hit 1.0234. Increasing DEPTH was good, but we're still far from 0.90. I'm going to try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to expand model capacity, as agent-3 and agent-4 suggested, while maintaining the current stable learning rate and warmup settings.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model capacity/width while keeping current depth and optimizer settings.
